spine: 1. 磁碟式 Git 的成本是 RAID、副本與分片再平衡；物件儲存把耐久、複製與容量接走，但 Git 的資料模型假設快速隨機存取。
2. WAL-on-S3（Cursor Continuity 與開源仿作）把規模與耐久移進桶，讀取擴展得好，但作者認為每個 push 仍得落在磁碟上的單一 repository，寫入實質是單一寫入者。
3. Enroute 只讓 ref 更新排隊（compare-and-swap），push 的前置工作由 compute 平行做；ledger 用 Raft 把提交壓到 1-2 毫秒，避開桶的往返。
4. 讀取側靠 segment 格式：每個 commit 一個 segment，delta 只指向 parent 的同一檔案，client 缺哪些 commit 就拿哪些 segment，不必走物件圖。
5. 小 push 先進日誌、約每秒 flush 一次、約八個同級 layer 合併，讓桶上昂貴的往返與 push 次數脫鉤。
6. 所有效能數字都是廠商自測：7,600 以上 push/秒、shallow clone 快 2 倍以上、完整 clone 慢約 17%、增量 fetch 慢約 13%；環境只有 EC2 與 S3 一句話，跨系統倍數作者自承設定不同。
7. 選擇規則：寫入速率在百次/秒量級就不必換；大量 agent 並行寫同一 repo 才值得評估 Enroute，且作者自列未完成項目（SSH、GC、冷啟動、快取設定）仍多，需自己用 forgemark 重跑。

perspective.mechanism: ledger（每個 repo 一份 Raft 日誌，記 refs 與 layer 清單）加無狀態 compute 加桶內不可變 layer；push 只排序 ref 更新，讀取靠按 commit 切開的 segment，不必走物件圖。
perspective.tradeoff: 拿掉單一寫入者的上限，換來完整 clone 約慢 17%、增量 fetch 約慢 13%、冷節點慢、GC 與 SSH 尚未完成；所有數字為廠商自測，環境描述極少。
perspective.reader_use: 台灣的基礎設施工程師可用文中的三路線對照判斷自己的瓶頸是讀還是寫；只有大量 agent 並行寫同一 repo 才需要評估，並應用 forgemark 在自己的環境重跑。

perspective.mechanism: README 把 Enroute 描述為建在物件儲存之上的可程式化 git 基礎設施，採 Apache-2.0。
perspective.tradeoff: README 只用來確認授權與定位；效能與設計細節仍以作者部落格為準。
perspective.reader_use: 確認授權為 Apache-2.0，可自行評估與重跑 benchmark。

notes.quote: has relied heavily on SSDs as the primary storage mechanism
notes.interpretation: 作者對磁碟式 Git 託管的描述；brief 與文章連結指向 GitHub 的 Spokes（dgit）架構作為例子。

notes.quote: Disks can fail, so one needs RAID and/or backups.
Servers can fail, so every repository needs replicas to be highly available.
And any disk eventually fills up, so repositories must be sharded and rebalanced across a fleet of file servers.
notes.interpretation: 成本之三：分片與再平衡。

notes.quote: The advantages are obvious: a bucket is durable, replicates itself and it never fills up.
notes.interpretation: 桶對應磁碟式的三項成本；對應關係是我的整理。

notes.quote: This only makes sense, since both the Git client but also the Git data model virtually assume fast random access storage.
Each object is its own key, and each GET only tells you which keys to fetch next.
notes.interpretation: 逐物件讀取的往返問題。

notes.quote: every one of these steps would be a 30-40ms round trip.
notes.interpretation: 前半句為 If one were to treat Git as just content-addressed storage on object storage；作者估算，非量測。

notes.quote: Most prominently, in August, Cursor/SpaceX described Continuity, their S3-backed Git storage
notes.interpretation: WAL-on-S3 代表；開源仿作的說法出自同一段 implementations。

notes.quote: Firstly, while they perform well when scaling out reads, they typically falter under write-heavy traffic.
And secondly, they still rely on the canonical Git CLI which memory maps files on disk,
With these improvements, Cursor reports up to 120 pushes/s on S3 Standard and more than 300 on S3 Express One Zone
notes.interpretation: Cursor 回報的數字，由 Enroute 文章轉引；我未讀 Cursor 原文。

notes.quote: At the end of the day, no matter how fast the WAL is, every push still has to land in one repository on disk.
However many servers you run, a repository can only ingest as fast as one machine can apply and compact.
A small cluster of nodes that keeps one replicated log per repository using Raft consensus.
The log holds the repository's refs and the list of layers that make up its data.
A layer is an immutable file of Git objects with its own index, much like a Git pack.
Committing a log entry typically requires 1-2 milliseconds of network and disk latency, not a bucket round trip.
notes.interpretation: ledger 提交延遲，語氣為 typically；作者自述。

notes.quote: With group commits, one fsync covers every push that arrives in the same moment, across all repositories.
Only the ref update is ordered, and it commits in milliseconds once two ledger nodes have it.
notes.interpretation: 只排序 ref 更新。「這是 push 關鍵路徑避開桶的原因」是我的整理，已在文中標為推測。

notes.quote: Compute is fully stateless and holds nothing but cache.
notes.interpretation: 無狀態 compute；另句 Compute nodes keep nothing that can't be rebuilt from the ledger and the bucket.

notes.quote: Most of a push’s work happens before it is committed
notes.interpretation: 後接索引 pack、驗證每個物件並重新編碼（閱讀時的內容）。

notes.quote: Compute nodes are capable of running this work in parallel without having to take any locks.
Only commits are applied in order through a compare-and-swap on the refs the push moves.
notes.interpretation: 序列化範圍縮到 ref 的 CAS。「從整個 repository 縮小」是我的整理。

notes.quote: Pushes to different branches never conflict and readers work on immutable snapshots, so they never starve writers.
Object storage is great for data at rest, but a conditional GET or PUT takes tens of milliseconds.
Small pushes are first stored in the ledger log.
About once a second they are merged into one file and uploaded: one upload for about 300 pushes.
notes.interpretation: 約每秒一次，約 300 個 push 一次上傳；兩個都是「about」。

notes.quote: Only layers larger than 1 MiB are uploaded directly to the bucket and then committed as a ledger entry.
Once about eight layers of similar size pile up, they are merged into one layer roughly eight times larger.
notes.interpretation: 約八個同級合併成約八倍。

notes.quote: Merges only copy bytes without recompressing them, so they are relatively inexpensive to run.
Only refs and the layer list remain on the ledger nodes in the long run.
notes.interpretation: 長期留在 ledger 的只有 refs 與 layer 清單。

notes.quote: Each segment holds the set of objects representing the delta to the commit’s parents.
Multiple consecutive segments are grouped into layers, which are immutable files with a table of contents at the end.
The segment of a commit in combination with its ancestors holds all necessary data that is reachable from a commit.
notes.interpretation: commit 加祖先的 segment 握有全部可達資料。

notes.quote: Enroute rebuilds object deltas in the segment by picking from possible delta bases constrained to the segment’s ancestors.
In Enroute, a delta only points to the same file in the parent commit, so a client that has the parent can use it directly.
notes.interpretation: delta 只指向 parent 的同一檔案。

notes.quote: The server's job is to send everything reachable from the requested commit without sending data already available.
A client missing C3 to C6 gets exactly those four segments, with no tree walk.
notes.interpretation: 例子。「每步往返成本不再按圖深度累加」是我的歸納，文中已說明。

notes.quote: The same object can appear in several commits' segments, but a valid packfile may contain each object only once.
Enroute deduplicates while building the object list, and then skips those duplicates during segment streaming.
A shallow clone has none of the parent commits, so objects stored as deltas at its boundaries have to be sent in full.
Enroute rebuilds them in bulk and caches the results, so repeated shallow clones with the same boundary can be fast.
notes.interpretation: 批次重建並快取，can be fast。

notes.quote: A clone with --filter=blob:none skips file contents and fetches single files later.
Layers cluster objects of the same kind closer together, to make it cheap to apply this type of filter.
It reads the refs and the layer metadata, fetches only the chunks it needs, and keeps them on disk for the next request.
When a request needs more data that isn't on disk, the node fetches just the chunks it needs, with parallel ranged GETs.
In our tests, a node with an empty disk served a full clone of linux.git in 128.6 seconds, against 126.0 seconds warm.
notes.interpretation: 作者自測；差距 2.6 秒為我的減法。

notes.quote: But even a cold cache costs less than you might think.
In these tests, Enroute demonstrates a peak performance of more than 7,600 pushes per second into a single repository.
Enroute takes 7,619 pushes per second into one repository
Running in the cloud on EC2 and S3
notes.interpretation: 環境描述僅此一句；我讀到的版本未見執行個體型號與叢集規模。

notes.quote: which is capable of simulating large numbers of concurrent agents
notes.interpretation: forgemark 的描述，後接 pushing to branches of one shared repository。

notes.quote: this is roughly 18 times what Entire.io reports
notes.interpretation: 對 Entire.io 回報的倍數，roughly。

notes.quote: more than 1,000 times what GitHub is currently able to handle
notes.interpretation: 對 GitHub 的倍數，數字為作者自己用 forgemark 跑的。

notes.quote: the numbers come from slightly different setups but give a good sense on the order of magnitude
notes.interpretation: 作者自承設定不同，只當量級參考。

notes.quote: The Enroute and GitHub numbers are our own forgemark runs
notes.interpretation: Enroute 與 GitHub 的數字為自測；Entire 的為對方回報。

notes.quote: a write-ahead log on local disk.
notes.interpretation: walgit 的描述；文章有 1 到 512 並行 push 的比較圖，內文沒有數字。

notes.quote: We compared Enroute with a warm and cold cache against stock Git 2.56.0
served by git http-backend behind Apache, using a repacked copy of linux.git
notes.interpretation: stock Git 的服務方式與資料。

notes.quote: Enroute managed to shine on the shallow benchmark, with its clones being more than 2x faster.
notes.interpretation: shallow clone 快 2 倍以上。

notes.quote: Partial clones are on par, full clones are about 17% slower and incremental fetches about 13% slower.
a warm cache mostly improves shallow clones and incremental fetches
notes.interpretation: 暖快取主要改善的項目。

notes.quote: Interestingly, the biggest performance gap is now on the client side.
notes.interpretation: 差距在 client 端。與 segment 格式的因果是我的推測，已在文中標為推測。

notes.quote: the Git client then spends more time validating the pack and decoding deltas than the server spent sending it.
notes.interpretation: client 花在驗證與解 delta 的時間較長。

notes.quote: Layers are immutable, so a deleted branch or a force-push leaves unreachable objects behind.
We need a way to find them and rewrite layers without blocking reads or pushes.
Enroute currently speaks Git over HTTP smart protocol.
SSH and a few less common parts of the protocol are still missing.
The fetch performance of a cold compute node lies far below what is possible once the node is warmed up and the cache is hot.
Enroute currently doesn't coordinate which compute node serves which repository,
notes.interpretation: 目前不協調 compute 與 repository 的對應；句子後半文中不引用。

notes.quote: Right now every node caches data the same way.
But it is only the start, and there is still a lot we want to improve and find out:
Enroute is open source.
we have built a new kind of git server that is based on modern database principles
notes.interpretation: tl;dr 的前半句，作者總括。

notes.quote: Not only is this effectively a single-writer system
notes.interpretation: 作者對 WAL 路線的評語（partial sentence）。

notes.quote: While these implementations have been successful in moving the burden of scalability and durability into object storage
notes.interpretation: 作者承認 WAL 路線的貢獻；implementations 含開源仿作。

notes.quote: Enroute is licensed under Apache-2.0.
to measure how quickly a new node gets fast on large repositories
notes.interpretation: 未完成清單中 compute 自動擴縮的項目（partial sentence）；表示新節點變快所需時間尚未量測。

notes.quote: Programmable git infrastructure on top of object storage.
notes.interpretation: README 定位語；post 未引用，僅用於確認專案性質。

notes.quote: We want the best of both worlds, and pick bases that are both fast to serve and fast to decode.
notes.interpretation: 作者把更聰明的 delta base 選擇列為待做，目標是同時快送出、快解碼。

notes.quote: We want to make it configurable what gets cached and for how long,
notes.interpretation: 作者想讓快取內容與時間可設定；目前每個節點的快取方式相同（見 n72）。
